blurb: Dairy Foods' 2026 Product of the Year: bourbon ice cream with black cherries and praline pecans, picked with 57% of the vote from 12 nominees.
Dairy Product of the Year at Scotland Food & Drink's 2026 Excellence Awards: a ricotta, pistachio and sour cherry gelato from Giacopazzi's, judged by a tasting panel.
Northern Ireland Regional Champion at the 2026 Great British Food Awards, with a Gold in the Ice Cream category for its gelato sold in a can.
Two golds at the 2026 Blas na hÉireann awards in Dingle: a mango sorbet and a wild berries frozen yoghurt, from more than 3,000 entries.
Ice Cream Grand Champion at World Dairy Expo 2026: peanut butter ice cream with salted caramel ripples, brownie chunks and chocolate-covered pretzels.
Gold in the open class at the 2026 New York State Fair Dairy Products Competition, which drew 187 entries across 26 categories.
Champion Ice Cream at the 2026 Melbourne Royal Australian Food Awards: Canopy Foods' salted walnut ice cream.
